<thought>Construct the retrosynthesis route JSON: the target molecule is the product of template 1914385, whose mapped reaction shows the product SMILES (after removing atom‑mapping and stereochemistry) as `COC(=O)C12CH=CHCH2C1C(=O)C2`. The reaction uses the two precursors returned by the apply‑template step: `C=CC=C` and `COC(=O)C1=CC(=O)C1`. The required format nests a reaction node under the product molecule node.</thought>
<final_answer>{
  "type": "mol",
  "smiles": "COC(=O)C12CH=CHCH2C1C(=O)C2",
  "children": [
    {
      "type": "reaction",
      "template_id": 1914385,
      "children": [
        {
          "type": "mol",
          "smiles": "C=CC=C"
        },
        {
          "type": "mol",
          "smiles": "COC(=O)C1=CC(=O)C1"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
